mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lungs to the circulation was most worthwhile because it brought the chapter’s parts together and traced oxygen to working tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the lining and then the capillary mesh felt a little repetitive, although the descriptions made their separate positions clear.

surprise.text: The chest and pleural connection clarified how the lungs expand: chest movement lowers lung pressure and draws air in.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and results gave a practical reason for each connection.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because seeing separate structures combine into a working body system was interesting, though the intermediate assembly was sometimes predictable.
